query:
SELECT
                COUNT(*) AS "total!: i64",
                COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN uw.status = 'known' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "known!: i64"
            FROM reading_article_word w
            LEFT JOIN reading_user_word uw ON uw.word = w.word
            WHERE w.article_id = ?
              AND (uw.status IS NULL OR uw.status != 'ignored')
